market_context: The Nasdaq-100 fell 1.39% to 27,989.82 (QQQ −1.36% to $681.09) as Monday’s early rebound faded into a fresh AI/tech selloff: Intel’s post-guidance collapse deepened, Marvell plunged on its $115B all-stock Lumentum deal, memory/storage extended losses after Kioxia’s soft outlook, and capital rotated into Dow/staples names including Walmart.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-02 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Marvell Technology Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: Officially announced an all-stock acquisition of Lumentum at a fixed 4.5 MRVL shares per LITE share (~$115B enterprise value / ~23.9% premium to the Oct 28 close); dilution, merger-arb, and a long 1H28 close timeline drove the session’s steepest drop even as management pitched >$1B cost synergies and a $550B AI-connectivity TAM.
